name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04, 238 commits) is a major release introducing Connect Knowledge for cloud drive integration (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), per-room agent Channels, and a Telegram remote-control gateway. Notable fixes include PBKDF2 password hashing with rate-limiting, Windows installer repairs, and clean-path routing replacing hash-based URLs. v0.6.0 adds a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes, v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and v0.6.0 following shortly after
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes, PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.
v0.6.0 moves to a new self-updater; future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases instead of the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet but is heavier and more complex to self-host.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell provides robust document processing and metadata extraction but requires more infrastructure setup compared to Cabinet's simplicity.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy is a full-featured document management system with user permissions and workflows, making it more capable but heavier than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Mayan EDMS
alternatives.review: Mayan EDMS is an enterprise-grade document management platform with extensive features that far exceed Cabinet's scope and simplicity.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash focuses on browsing and managing files across multiple storage backends, offering more connectivity options but less document-management focus than Cabinet.
